title: MinClaimDistance
description: Prevents claims from being too close together in the plugin HuskClaims
body: This plugin adds the ability to prevent claims (or send warning messages) when claims are too close to each other in the [HuskClaims](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/huskclaims-1-17-1-21-modern-golden-shovel-land-claiming-fully-cross-server-compatible.114467/) plugin
